title: The Paired Hawk Wind Course
summary: A school course in diving wind arts taught in pairs that ends in the school's signature fall of two hawks as one storm.

title: Manual of the Azure Court Gale
summary: A school manual of measured and stern wind arts that close on the judgement gale of the azure court.

title: The Dual-Track Wind Course
summary: A school course in dividing the wind into two tracks of attack and guard that ends in a twofold storm.

title: The Basin and River Wind Canon
summary: A school canon of winds that gather as a river gathers and meet at a point of confluence to break on a foe.

title: The Hawk Core Wind Canon
summary: A school canon that draws the wind from the formed core and rises with it to a signature ascent over the field.

title: The Wind-Sworn Course
summary: A school course for the wind-sworn that binds a student's oath to the wind and ends in the gale of that oath.

title: Handbook of the Long Bearing
summary: A school handbook of wind arts held over great distances along a taken bearing that ends in a far-reaching storm.

title: Treatise of the Open Plateau Wind
summary: A school treatise on the stripping winds of the open plateau that leave no cover standing and end in a sundering squall.

title: The Gale Oath of the High Wind
summary: A school canon of the oath taken at great height and of the high wind that carries it down as a sky-sworn storm.

title: The Core Oath Canon of the Gale
summary: A school canon that sets the wind-sworn oath in the formed core so that the gale it raises does not end.
